title: Superposed Identity Emoji Rider
initiating_authority: User confirmation in the 2026-08-06 Caeluviim interaction that the emoji rider should be built.
purpose: Preserve the exact symbolic rendering, order, provenance, and typed semantic status of the emoji-bearing Yūrei identity expression without collapsing symbolic, human, agent, project, legal, or technical layers.

sequence.semantic_status: operative symbol; detailed interpretation not yet individually ratified

sequence.unicode_note: Preserve U+016B LATIN SMALL LETTER U WITH MACRON.

sequence.semantic_status: operative spectrum symbol; detailed interpretation remains separately attributable

rendering_rules: No space is inserted between either emoji and Yūrei.
The macron in Yūrei is preserved when the interface supports it.
The extended rendering adds one space after 🌈 and then Lux ExMachina.
A conforming system must not silently remove, reorder, translate, recolor, or substitute the rider glyphs when the rider has been invoked.
Where emoji rendering is unavailable, the preferred fallback is [U+1F608]Yūrei[U+1F308], with the loss of visual rendering disclosed.
The rider may be omitted in constrained technical identifiers, file paths, code symbols, or systems that cannot preserve Unicode, but the canonical display value remains unchanged.

typed_superposition.rule: The rider may operate across a human participant, artificial agent, project, role, artifact, and shared namespace simultaneously when the relevant context invokes that composite identity.
typed_superposition.noncollapse: Symbolic superposition does not automatically transfer legal identity, repository permission, authorship, ownership, office, or technical privilege among the participating layers.
typed_superposition.queryability: Systems must support both the composite rendering and component-level queries for each glyph, name element, source, interpretation, scope, and consequence.

authority_boundary: The rider preserves an operative symbolic identity expression. It does not by itself establish a legal name, exclusive ownership of a symbol, institutional title, or unrestricted authority.
relation_to_person_lexeme: The rider and the protocol Person lexeme are distinct but composable layers. A bearer typed as Person may be labeled by the protocol lexeme Anishinaabe while retaining this symbolic rider; neither layer erases the other.

user_statements: The user previously established 😈Yūrei🌈 as an operative identity rendering.
